parameters.help_en:
The Internet service provider (ISP) of the 5G high-speed cloud access instance. Valid values:
telecom: China Telecom.
mobile: China Mobile.
unicom: China Unicom
parameters.help_zh:
5G高速上云实例的运营商。取值：
telecom：中国电信。
mobile：中国移动。
unicom：中国联通
parameters.name: isp

parameters.help_en: The description of the high-speed cloud access service
parameters.help_zh: 高速上云服务的描述信息
parameters.name: description

fields.help_en: The Access Point Name (APN) ID of the ISP
fields.name: apn

parameters.help_en: The list of established Cloud Connectors
parameters.help_zh: 已经建立的云连接器列表
parameters.name: net_links

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see How to ensure idempotence
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多详情，请参阅如何保证幂等性
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to only precheck the request. Valid values:
true: prechecks the request without creating the instance. The system checks whether all required parameters are specified, the request format, and service limits. If the request fails the precheck, the corresponding error is returned. If the request passes the precheck, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false (default): sends the request. If the request passes the precheck, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会创建实例组。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run
